text:
Alex Kim: Quick heads up — planning a small traffic-split to v2 for the billing/pricing endpoint tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need owners and deps verified.
Priya Nair: What's the exact path + header we expect clients to use? SDK owners need the spec to cut the patch.
Alex Kim: path: /api/billing/pricing -> new handler mounted at /api/v2/billing/pricing. Clients should send header `x-redwood-api-version: 2` or use the new SDK.
Diego Alvarez: I'll own the rollout (canary->10%->50%->100%). Canary metrics I'll watch: 95p latency, error-rate, token Δ, and downstream payment errors. Link to canary dashboard: https://redwood.test/dashboards/canary-billing
Samir Patel: SDK 2.4.0 ships the header toggle. Is there a fallback for older clients if header missing?
Alex Kim: yes — runtime will fallback to v1 unless `x-redwood-api-version: 2` present. We have a shim for legacy SDKs but it's a best-effort mapping for line items. Not perfect for edge-case promo calculations.
Priya Nair: SDK owners — estimated time to cut 2.4.0 with header support?
Samir Patel: I can cut a patch today, release tomorrow AM. Will add integration test against staging billing dataset. ping @Priya for integration spec.
Priya Nair: I'll attach the request/response golden set here in the doc. Also need docs + changelog entry before cut.
infra-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: build/infra/billing-canary #457 started by @Alex-K. ETA ~12m
Diego Alvarez: checklist I want before canary: healthcheck ok, DB migrations dry-run, rate-limit + quota sanity, rollout policy created. Tag me when ready.
Alex Kim: DB migration is backward-compatible (adds column with default). Rate-limit rules already configured. Will push rollout policy:
```
route: /api/v2/billing/pricing
traffic: 0.10
strategy: random-sample
flag: feature/billing-v2-traffic
```
Priya Nair: I'll coordinate SDK release notes + sample curl. Sample curl for QA:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-redwood-api-version: 2" https://api.redwood.ai/api/v2/billing/pricing
```
Samir Patel: QA will run smoke and regression tests in staging once canary is live. Expect ~30m test window after 10% rollout.
Diego Alvarez: I'll monitor rollback windows and have the fallback toggle ready. If we see >0.5% error-rate increase or 20% 95p latency bump, rollback to v1 automatically.
Alex Kim: Good — final ask: owners for SDK docs (Priya), canary monitoring + alerts (Diego), infra rollout config + runbook (Samir). If that mapping looks right, I'll kick the rollout at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: I can do docs + changelog.
Diego Alvarez: Oncall will be me for the 09:00 slot. Will post postmortem template if anything weird.
Samir Patel: I'll produce the runbook and the quick rollback CLI: `redwood rollback feature/billing-v2-traffic`.
Alex Kim: thanks team — tagging post-rollout check-in at 10:30 UTC. :clock10:
